_comment: Hand-reviewed live products that cannot be discovered completely from a protocol registry. Exact mints only: an issuer-level announcement never becomes an asset-level integration.

integrations.networkPath: Kraken embedded wallet on Ink → Veda vault → Solana Kamino market
integrations.accessNote: Available only to eligible Kraken clients; geographic restrictions apply and deallocation has a three-day processing window.
integrations.summary: Deposit the xStock into a self-custodial Veda vault through Kraken Pro. Sentora manages the strategy, which posts the xStock to Kamino, borrows stablecoins and returns yield in the deposited xStock.

evidence.note: Veda names exactly three supported assets: SPYx, QQQx and NVDAx, with Veda on Solana, Sentora as risk manager and Kamino as the lending market.
Kraken documents the deposit, self-custodial embedded wallet, wrapped vault accounting and three-day withdrawal window.
